Details for each step are in `MAINTAINING.md`.

- [ ] Replace the release keys
- [ ] Reread `docs/threat-model.md`
- [ ] Move `go.mod` and `go.work` to a newer Go toolchain
- [ ] Refresh every upstream in `dependencyBudget`
- [ ] Leave the fuzz targets going for a long session
- [ ] Repeat the benchmarks
